latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Video Publish skill.

- Upload edited video files and describe the desired result to quickly generate publish-ready videos (1080p MP4) in 30–60 seconds.
- No need for export settings or timeline dragging; the skill handles publishing preparation, optimization, and platform-ready exports.
- Connects automatically to the backend; authenticates with a free token for new users (100 credits, valid 7 days).
- Supports cloud-based rendering pipeline, accepting multiple common video and audio formats (e.g., mp4, mov, avi, webm, mp3, wav).
- Provides clear session management, export workflows, and user-friendly error handling.
- Allows batch processing and iterative editing within a session for fast social, demo, or product video publishing.
